summary: Backend + frontend test of new subscription batch. 5/6 backend tests passed; 1 backend bug found — /api/auth/me does not return plan_expires field. All 4 pay plan cards render, playground streams 3 tiers in ~8s, Gallery Spotlight iframe rotates real builds, mobile chat hides guest banner (desktop shows it).

critical.issue: Response omits plan_expires field. auth._public() only exposes id/email/name/role/plan. Trial plan approval sets plan_expires in DB correctly, but frontend cannot read it via /me — trial countdowns / expiry warnings will not work.

action_items: Fix auth._public() in /app/backend/auth.py to include plan_expires (and optionally doc_credits) so frontend can display trial countdown / gate features when trial lapses.
critical_code_review_comments: auth._public() is the single source of truth for auth responses but silently drops plan_expires and doc_credits — any new user-scoped field must be added there. Consider whitelisting fewer fields OR moving to a Pydantic response model.

Backend has no automatic enforcement of trial expiry — plan_expires is set on approve but never checked when gating /api/keys or PAID_PLANS in create_key. A user whose trial expired 30 days ago still gets subscription access.

cashapp/confirm early-returns when status is already 'approved' or 'pending_review' but does not overwrite sender_cashtag/note — probably intended, but if a user resubmits with a correction it will be lost.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 cashapp_payments docs for doctester1 (builder+trial), both approved during flow tests. Free user plan was reset back to 'free' with plan_expires unset via mongo at end (test_zz_reset_free_user_plan passed). No leftover paid data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contract for cashapp works: intent -> confirm -> admin approve -> plan updated. Trial plan sets plan_expires ~7d in DB but /auth/me hides it (bug). Frontend selectors confirmed: pay-plan-{trial,builder,luchii-pro,annual}, pay-start-btn, pay-plan-grid; model-playground + playground-input + playground-run-btn + playground-col-luchii-{1b,7b,70b} all present and streams complete in <10s; gallery-spotlight + spotlight-iframe (src=/api/p/{slug}) + spotlight-dots (5 dots) all present and auto-rotates every ~9s; chat-guest-banner has visible=False on mobile viewport and True on desktop as required. Login test on dashboard 402 flow was inconclusive because the frontend session did not persist through page.reload — backend 402 gate itself is verified via test_keys_free_user_returns_402. If retesting the UI 402 toast+redirect, use waitForResponse and check the Sonner/toast selector.
rca of the issue: GET /api/auth/me bug: /app/backend/auth.py line 53-55 defines `_public(user)` which returns a hand-picked dict with only {id, email, name, role, plan}. When admin approves a trial payment, /admin/cashapp/{ref}/approve sets both {plan:'trial', plan_expires:<iso>} on the users doc, but _public strips plan_expires from every downstream response (login, refresh, me, profile). Fix: add `"plan_expires": user.get("plan_expires")` (and probably `"doc_credits": user.get("doc_credits", 0)`) to the returned dict.
